metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating Q1 and Q2 totals for each sales rep with proper column headers. Verified with Python: First rep (Ivelisse Peel) Q1=696+420+722=1838, Q2=428+279+349=1056. Custom getter reads headers and all rep rows, metric awards 0.1 for each header and 0.8 proportionally based on correct calculations across all reps.
